race.comment: PROPHET'S PROMISE (3) comes here deep into the campaign and winning apprentice retains the ride. Savaged the line from back in the field when getting through the heavy going to salute over 1650m at Moruya. Sure to feature again. SNAP DECISION (4) is trained on the track, and he finds an easier race third up. Returned good closing splits with a fighting second over 1600m here. Can continue the good form and no shock to see him get the better of these. TOUSSAINT (7) frustrating mare who finally got the job done here last January. Never in the contest first up when eighth over 1400m at Kembla Grange to the progressive Harry Lime. Expecting a better effort up to the 1600m. LUNA BAY (1) outclassed first up from the wide draw with a battling ninth over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Claim helps in this easier contest.
